name: Ouyang Lianli
source:
Lillian owns a well-known luxury company but she doesn't own any share. Rumour has it the anonymous account she holds actually controls 90% of the shares of the company. Many people are suspicious but most think her unexpected appearance last year was the most dubious thing.

She looks after her employees well and is especially generous with Ophelia.
